method_en: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 resampled to 60 m (EPSG:32719). Slope from the elevation gradient, smoothed over 5 x 5 cells (300 m). Flood-sensitive = within 1.5 km of a channel with >= 100 km2 upstream area and less than 3 m above the nearest channel bed (HAND). Raster cells are counted inside the site boundary; areas are indicative to about 1%.

files.hillshade_note: 8-bit grey, sun from the north-west at 45 degrees, vertical exaggeration 1.5. hillshade_9_13.png is in EPSG:4326 with bbox [west, south, east, north]; hillshade_9_13_utm.png is in EPSG:32719 with bounds [minx, miny, maxx, maxy] in metres, the same grid as the DEM.
files.dem_png_note: The same DEM as a 16-bit greyscale PNG: each pixel value is the elevation in metres. Same grid and bounds as hillshade_9_13_utm.png (EPSG:32719, 60 m). Readable with Pillow alone.
